ev.q: Nineteen children with microcephaly at birth and laboratory evidence of Zika virus infection were assessed through clinical evaluations
This report describes a subsample of 19 children, aged 19–24 months, who participated in ZODIAC
Approximately three quarters of young children affected by Zika virus infection in this analysis had at least three of the specified co-occurring outcomes
Caregivers reported that eight children were previously hospitalized
Fifteen children had a global score below 40 on the HINE, indicating severe motor impairment
This report describes a subsample of 19 children, aged 19–24 months, who participated in ZODIAC

methods_quotes.q: Subsequent measurements are reported in standard deviations (SD) to better characterize growth deficiencies
microcephaly was defined as head circumference below the third percentile for gestational age and sex
Motor function, functional hearing, and functional vision were assessed using the Hammersmith Infant Neurologic Exam (HINE)
